About Our Brand And Products

OnTrack Outdoor is an Australian-owned outdoor retailer with over 9 years of experience helping people enjoy camping, hiking, caravanning and outdoor adventures. Through our TERRAN range, we focus on ultralight, durable gear designed for hikers, campers and travellers who value quality, simplicity and performance.

Popular TERRAN products include titanium cookware, mugs, cutlery, sporks, water bottles, whistles and carbon hiking poles. Our products are lightweight, durable and designed to last.

What Makes Us Different

• Australian-owned business with thousands of customers nationwide
• Premium products designed for people who value quality, performance and longevity
• Fast shipping from our Melbourne warehouse
• Dedicated customer support team
• Growing TERRAN range focused on ultralight and sustainable outdoor gear
• Competitive pricing and strong conversion rates

How Affiliates Can Earn

• Earn 10% commission on every referred sale
• Track all sales through your unique affiliate link
• Real-time reporting and performance tracking
• No limits on earnings
• Commission applies across our range, including TERRAN products

How To Promote Us

• Share your affiliate link on social media, blogs, websites or YouTube
• Create product reviews, gear guides and outdoor content
• Feature TERRAN products in hiking, camping and travel posts
• Recommend products you genuinely use and trust

Other Information

• Australian and New Zealand customers only
• Fast dispatch from Melbourne
• New products added regularly
• Manual affiliate approval process
• Friendly team available to support content creators and outdoor enthusiasts

Affiliate Program Terms & Conditions

By joining the OnTrack Outdoor Affiliate Program, you agree to the following terms:

Commission

  • Affiliates earn 10% commission on eligible referred sales.

  • Commissions are calculated on the product value excluding shipping, taxes and refunds.

  • Commissions are only paid on completed and fulfilled orders.

Referral Tracking

  • Sales are tracked using your unique affiliate link.

  • Referral attribution is subject to browser cookies and tracking technology.

  • OnTrack Outdoor is not responsible for commissions lost due to deleted cookies, ad blockers, browser settings or other tracking limitations.

Prohibited Activities

The following activities are not permitted:

  • Self-referrals or purchases made through your own affiliate link.

  • Creating multiple accounts to generate commissions.

  • Purchasing through your own affiliate link using another email address.

  • Misleading, deceptive or false advertising.

  • Using spam, unsolicited emails or automated messaging.

  • Bidding on OnTrack Outdoor, TERRAN, or related branded keywords in paid advertising without written permission.

  • Posting affiliate links on coupon, discount or cashback websites without written approval.

Any violation may result in commission cancellation and removal from the program.

Returns & Cancellations

  • Commissions will not be paid on refunded, cancelled, fraudulent or chargeback orders.

  • If a commission has already been approved for an order that is later refunded or cancelled, the commission may be reversed.

Program Approval

  • All affiliate applications are reviewed manually.

  • We reserve the right to approve, reject or remove affiliates at our sole discretion.

Changes

  • OnTrack Outdoor reserves the right to modify commission rates, program rules and affiliate benefits at any time.

  • Continued participation in the program constitutes acceptance of any updated terms.

Contact

Questions regarding the affiliate program can be directed to:

info@ontrackoutdoor.com.au
